annotations.title: Find the personal data in a document without redacting it (dry run)

description:
Find the personal data in a document WITHOUT producing a redacted file: a dry run that answers "what would be redacted?" so you (or the user) can check it before committing. Returns, per category (Person, Email, PhoneNumber, Address, Organization, Date, IBAN, CreditCard, and national IDs), how many distinct entities were found and on which pages. It never returns the detected text itself.

Use it when the user wants to see what will be removed first, to check that the right categories are covered, or to decide which terms to keep visible. When the user just wants the redacted file, call redact_pdf_and_wait directly instead.

The detection is billed like a redaction of the same pages (a document is charged once): producing the file afterwards with redact_detected_job costs nothing more, including with different pii_categories or terms passed to it.

If this call times out or fails after the job was created, call detect_pii again with only the job_id it returned: that reads the same detection, with no new upload.

Accepts PDF, JPEG and PNG. Pass a photo or screenshot directly; do NOT convert it to a PDF first, that is handled for you and the output comes back as a redacted PDF either way.

The result has job_id: pass it to redact_detected_job to write the redacted PDF with these settings (or with changed ones).

PRIVACY: when the user wants the document anonymized, pseudonymized or kept away from the AI, do NOT open, Read, cat, preview or summarize the original file before calling this tool: pass its path and nothing else. Reading it first puts the personal data into this conversation and defeats the purpose. The same goes for the correspondence CSV and any "-restored" file: they contain the real names, so never read them either.

file_path.description: Absolute path to the file on this machine. PDF, JPEG and PNG are all accepted — pass an image directly rather than converting it first. This server runs locally, so it reads the file directly; never paste file contents into this argument, and do not open the file yourself first when the user wants its personal data kept out of the conversation.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. By default a key is derived from the file bytes (or the upload_id) and settings, so repeating an identical call returns the SAME job instead of redacting twice and counting the pages against the account twice. Pass a distinct value here only when you deliberately want a second, separate redaction of the same document.

job_id.description: Resume only: the job_id of a detection already started (from a detect_pii result or error). Pass it with no document source to read that detection again.

mode.description: "redact" (default) draws black boxes. "pseudonymize" replaces each person, organization, address, email, phone number, date, IBAN and card number with a consistent tag such as [Person 1] or [Org 2] (spelled in the document's language, e.g. [Personne 1] in French) — the same tag on every page and, as a rule, for every variant of a name ("Anna Keller", "Ms Keller", "A. Keller" become [Person 1]; a bare surname shared by two people goes to the one mentioned last, and the user can merge or split tags in the Studio) — so the document stays readable for a colleague or another AI while the names are gone. The text is still removed from the file, not covered. With pseudonymize, redact_pdf_and_wait also returns the tag -> original correspondence table (CSV; on the hosted server as a download link for the user, never inline); keep it with the user, it re-identifies the document. Other categories (national IDs, custom terms) stay black.

pii_categories.description: Which entity types to redact. OMIT this to use the account defaults, which is usually what the user wants — do not pass an empty list, which would mean "redact nothing" and return an unredacted file. Valid values: Person, Email, PhoneNumber, Address, Organization, Date, IBAN, CreditCard.

pii_excluded_terms.description: Terms that must NEVER be redacted even if detected as PII — typically your own company name, a public contact address, or the recipient the document is addressed to.

pii_included_terms.description: Terms that must ALWAYS be redacted even when the model would not treat them as PII — project codenames, internal references, a specific case number. Matched whole-word and case-insensitive. Wins over excluded terms on conflict.

retention.description: "ephemeral" (default) deletes the original after processing and keeps the output only briefly. "studio" keeps the original and the detected masks so a human can review and adjust them at redact-pdf.ai before exporting — use it for high-stakes documents where a person should sign off.

timeout_seconds.description: How long to wait for completion, in seconds (default 300, max 900; on the hosted server never more than 180, whatever is asked). On timeout the job keeps running server-side and can be resumed with get_job_status.
